newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank drains SKK400 mln in rev repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank drains SKK400 mln in rev repo tender.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Monday it had drained funds totalling 400 million crowns ($12.3 million) at this morning's seven-day securities reverse repurchase agreement tender.
The average rate firmed to 17.3 percent from 17.26 percent on Friday, NBS Open Market Operations Department Head Peter Andresic told Reuters.
He said the tender was oversubscribed, with 400 million crowns worth of bids from a total of 500 million being accepted.
